web.caption: MetalArm on the web
web.voice: This is MetalArm: a strength tracker that turns every workout into progress you can see, and a game you want to keep playing.

web.caption: Sign in - your training follows you
web.voice: Sign in, and everything comes with you. Your workouts, records and rank live on your account, not on one device.

web.caption: Home: level, rank, XP and streak
web.voice: Home is your status screen. Your level, your rank, how much experience until the next one, and your streak.

web.caption: A freeze saved your streak
web.voice: Missed a week? A streak freeze stepped in automatically. Rest weeks are part of training, so the streak survives one.

web.caption: Daily and weekly quests, made for your path
web.voice: Every day and every week, MetalArm hands out quests built for how you train. Progress fills in by itself as you lift. One reroll a day if a quest doesn't suit you.

web.caption: Your own quests, your own rewards
web.voice: You can add your own habits too, like stretching or sleep. Completing one pays experience, and here it tips us into a new level.

web.caption: Live duels on the home screen
web.voice: Running duels sit right on the home screen, with a head-to-head bar so you always know who's ahead.

web.caption: Start a workout
web.voice: Starting a workout takes one tap: a ready-made plan for your training style, one of your routines, or an empty session.

web.caption: Every movement, with a demo
web.voice: Each exercise card shows what you lifted last time, a hint for what to try next, and a demo of the movement.

web.caption: Log a set in one tap
web.voice: Logging is built for one hand. Nudge the weight and reps, tap log, and the rest timer starts on its own.

web.caption: Personal records, celebrated
web.voice: Beat a best, and MetalArm notices. Records are checked on the server the moment the set lands.

web.caption: Quests move as you lift
web.voice: The quest chip shows which quest that set just pushed forward. When one completes, you get a short moment, smaller than a record.

web.caption: Say it or type it: bench 82.5 for 5
web.voice: Hands full of chalk? Hold the mic and say the set, or type it. MetalArm turns plain words into a set you confirm with one tap.

web.caption: “Same again” repeats your last set
web.voice: Say same again, and it repeats your last set. Nothing is ever logged without your tap, and undo is right there.

web.caption: Fix a typo, honestly
web.voice: Made a typo? Edit or delete any set while the workout is live. Points and records are recalculated, never guessed.

web.caption: Finish: points, records, quests, streak
web.voice: Finishing banks your points, judges volume records, and shows which quests moved and where your streak stands.

web.caption: A share card for your story
web.voice: Every workout makes a share card, ready for your story.

web.caption: Progress: charts, records, history, body
web.voice: Progress shows the long game: strength over time per lift, every personal record, your full history, and your body weight.

web.caption: Parties: your crew
web.voice: Parties are your crew. A weekly workout board, a league to climb, shared quests, and a raid boss you only beat together.

web.caption: Fair duels: you vs. your own best
web.voice: Duels are where MetalArm is different. Fair modes score you against your own baseline, so a beginner can beat a veteran by improving more.

web.caption: Pick a mode - unfair ones say why
web.voice: Pick a mode. If one isn't fair for the two of you yet, it says why instead of letting you start it.

web.caption: Win, draw or a good fight
web.voice: When a duel ends, both sides get their moment. Lose, and you still earn points for showing up, with a rematch one tap away.

web.caption: What your crew has been doing
web.voice: The activity feed shows what your crew has been up to: records, rank-ups and finished workouts.

web.caption: Spend points on real rewards
web.voice: Points are a currency. Set your own rewards, and redeem them when you've earned them.

web.caption: Build your own routines
web.voice: Build routines of your own, with target sets, reps and rest for every exercise.

web.caption: Badges, character and rank trials
web.voice: Your profile holds your badges, your character sheet, and the strength trials that guard each rank. You can also import your history from Strong or Hevy.

web.caption: Rank up
web.voice: And when a rank falls, it's an event.

web.caption: MetalArm - lift. level. repeat.
web.voice: That's MetalArm on the web. Next, the same training on iPhone.

ios.caption: MetalArm on iPhone
ios.voice: On iPhone, MetalArm opens with a short welcome.

ios.caption: Create an account
ios.voice: Create an account in a few seconds.

ios.caption: Pick how you train
ios.voice: Choose a training path: athletic, bodybuilding or powerlifting. It shapes your workouts and quests.

ios.caption: Home: level, tier, streak, trial
ios.voice: Home shows your level, tier, streak and the next rank trial.

ios.caption: Ready-made workouts
ios.voice: Ready-made workouts are matched to your path.

ios.caption: A demo of every movement
ios.voice: Every movement has a demo, so you know the form before you lift.

ios.caption: Start a workout
ios.voice: Start, and your session is live.

ios.caption: What to try next
ios.voice: Hints suggest the next weight from your recent sessions.

ios.caption: Log a set - a personal record
ios.voice: Log a set, and a record is caught instantly.

ios.caption: The summary
ios.voice: Finish for the full summary of what you earned.

ios.caption: Share card
ios.voice: And a card to share it.

ios.caption: History and records
ios.voice: Progress keeps your history and records.

ios.caption: League and raid
ios.voice: Ranks shows your league and your party's raid.

ios.caption: Character sheet
ios.voice: Your character sheet grows with your training path.

ios.caption: Rank trials
ios.voice: Rank trials are real strength tests guarding each rank.

ios.caption: Import, reminders, Apple Health
ios.voice: Settings import your old history, set reminders, and connect Apple Health.

ios.caption: Rank up
ios.voice: One more workout, and the promotion.
